name: Default Render Layer
description: Default render layer that renders a model with a texture.

fields.description: The model layer to render. Can be a plain model layer like "example:model#main", or an object with a "base" and "variables" to switch between model layers while rendering, the same way dynamic textures do.
The texture to render the model with.
The render type to render the model with.
The light emission of the model. Must be within 0 - 15

name: Compound Render Layer
description: A compound render layer that can contain multiple render layers.

fields.description: The list of render layers this compound render layer contains.

name: Lightning Sparks
description: Renders lightning sparks around the entity.

fields.description: The frequency of the sparks.
The amount of sparks to spawn during each occurence.
The render settings for the sparks.

Model parts the sparks are limited to, like "right_arm" or "head". Each spark picks one of them and stays inside the box of that part, moving along with it. Nested parts can be written as a path like "body.cape". If none are specified, the sparks fill the whole hitbox of the entity.

name: Block on Head
description: Renders a block on the top of the entity's head.

fields.description: ID of the block/block state definition

name: Vibration
description: Renders a vibration effect on the entity.

fields.description: The intensity of the vibration, i.e. how many offset copies of the entity get blended in. Values above 32 are capped.
The time/ticks it needs for the vibration to fade in/out.

name: Thrusters
description: Renders thrusters on the end of each limb of the player.

fields.description: The texture to render the thrusters with.
Scale for the thruster
Bones of the player model where the thruster will be attached to
The color of the thrusters.
The texture of the camera-facing bloom rendered at each thruster.
The color of the bloom.
Size multiplier for the bloom, relative to the thruster part. Set to 0 to disable.

name: Cloth Render Layer
description: Renders a physically simulated cloth grid (a cape, by default) that flows, bends and trails behind the wearer instead of rotating as a rigid plane.

fields.description: Which part of the cloth grid is pinned to the wearer: "back" (cape), "left_arm" or "right_arm" (draped along an arm), or "waist" (skirt or kilt, a box-shaped loop around the hips).
A registered material id (e.g. "argon:heavy") or an inline object overriding individual physics properties.

[length, width] of the cloth at rest, in blocks. For a "waist" attachment, "width" is instead the HALF-WIDTH of its box cross-section's left/right sides (not a flat width) - see "depth" for the front/back sides.
[segments_x, segments_y]: simulation columns/rows. More = smoother bending at a performance cost.
Only meaningful for a "back" attachment: curves the pinned edge's rest shape forward so it hugs the wearer's sides, turning a flat cape into a wrap-around cloak. 0 = flat.
Waist attachment only: half-depth of the box's front and back sides, in blocks. Usually smaller than "width", since players are thinner front to back. Defaults to "width".
Waist attachment only: while crouching, the garment follows the body's pitch as one rigid piece. This scales how much, from 0 (ignored) to 1 (fully).
Currently unused - kept only so existing configs that set it don't fail to load.

[x, y, z] offset of the attach point from the neck, in wearer space: Y=0 is neck height and increasing Y moves DOWN; a cape needs a positive Z to sit behind. For "waist", use X=0, Z=0 and Y about 0.75-0.9.

Only meaningful for a "back" attachment: the width at the shoulders (the pinned edge) as a fraction of the full width at the hem, from 0.05 to 1. Below 1 the cloth is a trapezoid that is narrow at the shoulders and flares out to "width" at the hem, like a cape. 1 = a plain rectangle.

fields.type: { airflow_strength, turn_inertia, flight_stabilization, flight_stiffness_multiplier, stiffness_response, body_hug, hug_start, limb_collision, narrowing, flutter }
fields.description: How the cloth reacts to the wearer's real speed, not the selected flight level. Keys: airflow_strength (1), turn_inertia (1), flight_stabilization (0.6, calms swinging at speed), flight_stiffness_multiplier (1.15), stiffness_response (0.1) and body_hug (0.75, how tightly a back cape is pulled against the body near top speed) and hug_start (0.6, how far through the speed range the hugging begins). "narrowing" (not for "waist"): { enabled, start_fraction (0.25) and full_fraction (0.85) of the wearer's top flight speed, start_speed (10 blocks/s) and full_speed (40) when there is no flight, maximum (0.6; 0.35 when "wrap" is above 0 or for arms), compression (0.5, how much of the narrowing squeezes the cloth itself instead of folding it), response (0.06), recovery (0.04), distribution (1.5, higher keeps the top wider), fold (1, 0 turns the pleats off) }. "limb_collision" (back capes): { enabled (true), torso: { width (0.5), depth (0.25), length (1.1), radius (0.1) }, head: { width (0.5), depth (0.5), length (0.5), radius (0.1) }, arms: { radius (0.3), length (0.8) }, legs: { radius (0.25), length (0.8) } }, the shapes the cloth is kept out of. "flutter": { intensity (1), frequency (1), speed_influence (1), damping (0.6), edge_multiplier (1.5) }.
The texture to render the cloth with. UVs are stable across the whole grid regardless of how the cloth deforms.
The render type to draw the cloth with.
Player model parts to shrink while this layer renders, as for every pack render layer.

name: Fade Render Layer
description: Wraps another render layer and draws it at a changing opacity so it can fade in and out. Put the wrapped layer's conditions inside "layer". Nothing is drawn at opacity 0.

fields.description: (Dynamic) 0-1: how opaque the wrapped layer is drawn. Typically the eased animation timer of an ability, e.g. palladium.get_animation_timer_eased('namespace:power#ability'), which already runs 0 to 1.
The render layer to draw, written exactly as it would be on its own, including its "conditions".

name: Anchored Lightning Sparks
description: Like Palladium's Lightning Sparks, but sparks can be anchored to named body-part bones instead of spawning anywhere in the bounding box, using the same "anchors" as the Thrusters layer.

fields.description: The frequency of the sparks.
The amount of sparks to spawn during each occurence, per anchor (or once for the whole entity if "anchors" is empty).
The render settings for the sparks.

Bones of the player model to spawn sparks at, e.g. "head", "right_arm" - each gets its own independent spark cycle. Empty (the default) spawns sparks randomly across the whole entity, matching palladium:lightning_sparks.
Only relevant when "anchors" isn't empty: how far, in blocks, sparks jitter from the anchor point.
[x, y, z] offset applied after positioning at the anchor (or the whole entity, if "anchors" is empty) - lets sparks sit slightly away from the bone's exact pivot instead of centered on it.
Player model parts to shrink while this layer renders, as for every pack render layer.
